scenes.text: Spring's JUnit support loads our configuration before the test. It creates a repository and supplies it to our service.
scenes.phonemes: spɹˈɪŋz dʒˈeɪ jˈuːnɪt səpˈɔːɹt lˈoʊdz ˌaʊɚ kənfˌɪɡjɚɹˈeɪʃən bᵻfˌɔːɹ ðə tˈɛst. ɪt kɹiːˈeɪts ɐ ɹᵻpˈɑːzɪtˌɔːɹi ænd səplˈaɪz ɪt tʊ ˌaʊɚ sˈɜːvɪs.

scenes.text: Retrieve the required service bean from the context.
scenes.phonemes: ɹᵻtɹˈiːv ðə ɹᵻkwˈaɪɚd sˈɜːvɪs bˈiːn fɹʌmðə kˈɑːntɛkst.

scenes.text: Compare its repository with the context's repository. Assert they're the same object. Matching values aren't enough.
scenes.phonemes: kəmpˈɛɹ ɪts ɹᵻpˈɑːzɪtˌɔːɹi wɪððə kˈɑːntɛksts ɹᵻpˈɑːzɪtˌɔːɹi. ɐsˈɜːt ðeɪɚ ðə sˈeɪm ˈɑːbdʒɛkt. mˈætʃɪŋ vˈæljuːz ˌɑːɹnt ɪnˈʌf.

scenes.text: Run the smoke test. It passes: context loaded, required bean found, expected dependency confirmed.
scenes.phonemes: ɹˈʌn ðə smˈoʊk tˈɛst. ɪt pˈæsᵻz: kˈɑːntɛkst lˈoʊdᵻd, ɹᵻkwˈaɪɚd bˈiːn fˈaʊnd, ɛkspˈɛktᵻd dᵻpˈɛndənsi kənfˈɜːmd.

scenes.text: This checks wiring for our configuration. Test order behavior separately. Load, look up, assert.
scenes.phonemes: ðɪs tʃˈɛks wˈaɪɚɹɪŋ fɔːɹ ˌaʊɚ kənfˌɪɡjɚɹˈeɪʃən. tˈɛst ˈɔːɹdɚ bᵻhˈeɪvjɚ sˈɛpɹətli. lˈoʊd, lˈʊk ˈʌp, ɐsˈɜːt.
